latest_release.name: Voxt v2.0.3
latest_release.body:
### Requirements

- A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later.

### Install

- Open Voxt-2.0.3-arm64.dmg and drag Voxt to Applications. It replaces Voxt 1.x there.
- This version does not update itself: install a newer one the same way.


### Changed

- **Plainer text across the app**: about 300 English strings stop chaining clauses with colons and semicolons and leave out details nobody needs, about 360 Chinese strings read as written in Chinese and name each thing one way, and about 50 help texts that only said what the page already shows are gone. In Chinese, Rewrite is now 改写 (转写 also meant a transcript), a transcript is 转录稿, speech models are 语音识别模型 and an app is always App.
- **Sound: Built-in, macOS or None** (Settings → Audio): one choice says where the recording's start and stop sounds come from. Built-in lists six pairs of a start and a stop sound, each to try with ▶ and pick with a click; macOS picks a system sound for each; None plays nothing. The default pair is now Pebble and Nib, softer than Tally and Wrap. The panel of sounds by group, tag and search is gone, and so is Use Voxt 1.x's sounds: macOS starts on Pop and Tink.
- **Settings sits in the sidebar's System section**, under Logs, instead of a row of its own at the foot of the sidebar; the version number is on About. In the icon rail its icon is in that section too, with the dot while there are notifications.

### 中文

#### 变更

- **中英文文案过了一遍**：约 300 条英文不再用冒号、分号把几句硬连在一起，也删掉了用不着的细节；约 360 条中文去掉了翻译腔，同一个东西只用一种叫法；约 50 条只是重复界面内容的说明删掉了。Rewrite 改叫“改写”（原来的“转写”也指转录稿），会议和文件的 transcript 统一叫“转录稿”，语音模型统一叫“语音识别模型”，app 统一写作“App”。
- **音效：自带、系统或无**（设置 → 音频）：一个选项决定录音开始和结束的提示音从哪里来。“自带”列出 6 组成对的开始音和结束音，点 ▶ 试听，点一下选中；“系统”给开始和结束各选一个 macOS 声音；“无”就不响。默认换成更轻的 Pebble 和 Nib（原来是 Tally 和 Wrap）。按分组、标签和搜索找声音的面板去掉了，“使用 Voxt 1.x 的提示音”也去掉了：选“系统”默认就是 Pop 和 Tink。
- **“设置”放进了侧边栏的“系统”分组**，在“日志”下面，不再单独占侧边栏底部一行；版本号在“诊断与关于”里。侧边栏收成图标时，“设置”图标也在这一组里，有通知时照样显示红点。

### Build

- Built from 4e03928295bba17c8196644f50d69e58facff6ea by the Voxt Release workflow. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The SHA-256 checksum is attached.

## What's Changed
* [Voxt] Sign and notarize a nightly build of main by @XXXXRT666 in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3637
* [Docs] Shorten Get Started and align documentation paths with navigation by @AkazaAkane in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3607
* [Voxt] Import Voxt 1.x settings, add a speech context, build a signed beta of each merge, fix two layout bugs by @XXXXRT666 in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3655
* [Cleanup][Fun-CosyVoice3] Halve the DSpark exact verify's cost and kernel launches by @YifanLi3 in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3470
* [MLX] Native Fish S2-Pro server on the C++ runtime by @JiaxinD in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3142
* [Profiler] Capture CPU operations from scheduler threads by @DerekSun02 in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/2419
* [Benchmark][Speculative] Add SeedTTS workloads to the draft sweep by @swsqy in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3585
* [Speculative][P5.5] Validate Qwen3-ASR realtime transcription with the DFlash draft by @HaolingPu in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3572
* [Qwen3-Omni] Forward the dialog configure to qwen_omni in the H100 session cfg by @0xjeffro in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3662
* [Fix] Reject negative ASR temperature and fall back to soundfile when torchcodec cannot decode by @HaolingPu in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3634
* [Benchmark] Retry in-session admission rejections in the duplex recorder (C2) by @ychu824 in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3038
* [Qwen3-ASR] Honor repetition_penalty on CUDA and Torch MPS by @minyi-tang in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/pull/3415
* [Voxt] 2.0.2: Voxt 1.x parity — shortcut presets, mouse buttons, translate fallback, in-app upda

Blog | Documentation | Quick Start | Cookbook | SGLang | Join Slack

⭐ Star SGLang-Omni to help more builders discover open infrastructure for multimodal and speech serving!

## News - [2026/11] 🎙️ [Voxt 2.0](./Voxt/README.md) redefines open-source voice interaction on Mac: voice input, any-to-any translation, and a local AI assistant, with a 92% shorter wait after long dictation than 1.x. \[[Download](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/releases/download/voxt-v2.0.3/Voxt-2.0.3-arm64.dmg)\] \[[Changelog](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/blob/main/Voxt/CHANGELOG.md)\] - [2026/11] 🔁 OpenRSI × SGLang-Omni: recursive self-improvement (RSI) scaled to production AI infrastructure, with 14 merged PRs across 8 speech and omni models and +7.6% to +326.5% throughput on H100. \[[Blog](https://index.openrsi.foundation/blog/2026/openrsi-sglang-omni/)\] - [2026/10] 🗺️ A unified runtime for interactive intelligence: native full-duplex models, turn-based multimodal models, and cascaded systems, coordinated through composable graphs and persistent sessions. \[[Blog](https://www.sglang.io/blog/omni-interactive-runtime)\] - [2026/10] 🚀 SGLang-Omni **v0.2.0** is on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/sglang-omni/). Install with `uv pip install --prerelease=allow "sglang-omni==0.2.0"`. \[[Installation](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/get_started/installation.html)\] - [2026/10] 🐟 Day-0 support for [Fish Audio Drama 3](https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3): multi-speaker text-to-speech with voice cloning and natural-language control, streamed on `/v1/audio/speech`. \[[Blog](https://www.sglang.io/blog/spg-topology)\] \[[Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fishaudio_drama3.html)\] \[[Technical Report](https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech/tree/main/docs/assets/Fish_Audio_Drama_3_Technical_Report.pdf)\] - [2026/10] 🎙️ Introducing [Voxt](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/tree/main/Voxt), an open-source voice input tool for Mac, now integrating SGLang-Omni for faster local speech recognition on Apple Silicon. Combine ASR with LLM-based text refinement and personal system prompts for accurate technical terminology and personalized voice input, with fully local or remote inference options. [[Download](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/releases/download/voxt-v2.0.3/Voxt-2.0.3-arm64.dmg)][[Demo]](https://x.com/GenAI_is_real/status/2109419016205017181)
Earlier news - [2026/09] 🐧 Day-0 support for [AuK](https://huggingface.co/tencent/AuK) and [AuK-Flash](https://huggingface.co/tencent/AuK-Flash): text + voice instructions → 24 kHz speech on `/v1/audio/speech`, audio + editing instructions → edited speech on `/generate`. \[[Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/auk.html)\] - [2026/08] 🎵 Day-0 support for [MiniMax Music 3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3): lyrics + caption → 32 kHz stereo song on `/v1/audio/speech`. \[[Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/minimax_music3.html)\] - [2026/08] 🚀 TTS architecture refactor: shared pipeline state, engine construction, reference encoding, capability metadata, and vocoder scheduling. \[[Roadmap](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni/issues/985)\] \[[Blog](https://github.com/zhaochenyang20/Awesome-ML-SYS-Tutorial/blob/main/sglang/sglang-omni/tts-refactor.md)\] - [2026/06] 🔥 MOSS-TTS Local Transformer v1.5 on SGLang-Omni with native-streaming 48 kHz speech. \[[Blog](https://lmsys.org/blog/2026-06-17-moss-tts-local-v15/)\] \[[Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_tts_local.html)\] - [2026/06] 🔥 Higgs Audio v3 TTS for real-time, controllable speech. \[[Blog](https://lmsys.org/blog/2026-06-04-higgs-audio-v3-tts/)\] \[[Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/higgs_tts.html)\]
## About SGLang-Omni is a multi-stage serving runtime for omni, speech, and TTS models. Its design target is multi-stage decoding: generation split across heterogeneous stages with different compute patterns, dependency structures, and resource needs. SGLang-Omni owns the pipeline topology, stage lifecycle, inter-stage transport, model-family integration layer, and OpenAI-compatible serving surface, while composing with [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) for high-performance autoregressive scheduling and model execution where applicable. - **Multi-stage runtime**: SGLang-Omni models generation as coordinated stages: preprocessing, encoders, autoregressive engines, talkers, decoders, vocoders, and aggregators. - **Stage-specialized scheduling**: Each stage runs behind a scheduler matched to its workload, from SGLang-backed autoregressive scheduling to lightweight preprocessing and streaming vocoder loops. - **Transport-aware execution**: A control plane coordinates requests while the relay data plane moves tensor payloads across shared-memory, NCCL, NIXL, and Mooncake backends. - **API surface**: OpenAI-compatible endpoints expose multimodal chat, speech generation, batch speech, streaming speech, uploaded voices, and transcription. ## What SGLang-Omni Serves - **Omni chat and speech**: [Qwen3-Omni](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/qwen3_omni.html), [MiniCPM-o 4.5](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/minicpm_o.html), [Ming-Omni](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming_omni.html), [Ming-3.0-audio-flash](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming3_audio.html) — multimodal understanding and text/audio replies. - **Native full-duplex conversation**: [MiniCPM-o 4.5](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/minicpm_o.html), [PersonaPlex](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/personaplex.html), [NemotronLabs VoiceChat](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/nemotron_voicechat.html) — live listening and speaking over `/v1/realtime`, including camera input with MiniCPM-o. [Full-duplex guide](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/developer_reference/full_duplex_guide.html). - **Cascaded voice assistants**: Compose ASR → LLM → TTS services into streaming, turn-based conversations with voice activity detection, conversation history, turn taking, and interruption. [Streaming cascade guide](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/developer_reference/full_duplex_guide.html#streaming-cascade). - **Image and video generation**: [LLaDA2.0-Uni](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/llada2_uni.html) for text/image understanding, image generation, and editing; [Cosmos3 Nano](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/cosmos3_nano.html) for interleaved understanding and generation, with native image, video, and action routes. - **Music generation**: [MiniMax Music 3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/minimax_music3.html) — lyrics + caption → 32 kHz stereo song. - **Speech generation**: [Higgs Audio v3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/higgs_tts.html), [MOSS-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_tts.html), [MOSS-TTS Local](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_tts_local.html), [Fish Audio Drama 3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fishaudio_drama3.html), [Fish Speech S2-Pro](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fishaudio_s2_pro.html), [Qwen3-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/qwen3_tts.html), [Fun-CosyVoice3](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fun_cosyvoice3.html), [Voxtral TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/voxtral_tts.html), [Ming-Omni-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming_tts.html), [Ming-3.0-TTS](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming3_tts.html), [dots.tts](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/dots_tts.html), [ZONOS2](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/zonos2.html) — `/v1/audio/speech`, with batch, streaming, and voice features varying by model. - **Instruction-driven speech generation and editing**: [AuK and AuK-Flash](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/auk.html) — text and voice instructions → speech; audio and editing instructions → edited speech. - **Audio transcription**: [Qwen3-ASR](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/qwen3_asr.html), [Fun-ASR](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/fun_asr.html), [ARK-ASR](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/arkasr.html), [Nemotron 3.5 ASR](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/nemotron3_5_asr.html), [Nemotron Transcribe](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/nemotron_transcribe.html), [Ming-3.0-ASR](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/ming3_asr.html), experimental [Whisper](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/whisper_asr.html), and [MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/moss_transcribe_diarize.html) via `/v1/audio/transcriptions`. MOSS-TD also returns speaker labels and timestamps (`response_format=verbose_json`). - **Speaker diarization**: [Nemotron 3 Diarization](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/nemotron_diarization.html) — speaker intervals for uploaded recordings and live audio, including overlapping speech. - **Speech translation**: [Hy-SimulMT](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/hy_simulmt.html) — Chinese speech → English text and English speech → Chinese text, with file and realtime translation. See the [audio translation guide](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/basic_usage/audio_translations.html) for endpoint and model support. ## Hardware Support | Backend | Status | Notes | |---------|--------|-------| | **NVIDIA CUDA** | Supported | Default backend with full model coverage. | | **Apple Silicon** | Experimental | Qwen3-ASR runs through Torch MPS on macOS arm64. Install with [`install.sh`](./install.sh) and follow the [Qwen3-ASR guide](./docs/cookbook/qwen3_asr.md#apple-silicon). | | **Intel GPU (XPU)** | Supported | Intel Arc GPUs via PyTorch XPU. **Qwen3-ASR, Whisper ASR, Fun-ASR-Nano, Nemotron 3.5 ASR, MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize, Qwen3-TTS, Fun-CosyVoice3, ZONOS2, Audar-TTS, Qwen3-Omni, MiniMax Music 3, MiniCPM-o, Ming-Omni, Ming-Omni-TTS, Nemotron VoiceChat, PersonaPlex, AuK/AuK-Flash and dots.tts serve end-to-end**. The [Intel XPU guide](./docs/other_platforms/installation_xpu.md) has the install steps, each model's launch command and how many cards it needs; the backend is auto-detected. | Additional model guides, including experimental and research-oriented paths, are available in the [Cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/). ## Quick Start - [Installation](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/get_started/installation.html) - [TTS usage](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/basic_usage/tts.html) - [ASR cookbook](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/cookbook/qwen3_asr.html) ## Community & Support SGLang-Omni welcomes contributors working on inference systems, kernels, scheduling, inter-stage communication, model runners and cache efficiency, model integration, benchmarking, production deployment. Join the [SGLang Slack](https://slack.sglang.io) or read the [developer reference](https://sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni/developer_reference/main.html). Organizations interested in supporting SGLang-Omni, TTS, or omni model serving can contact Chenyang Zhao at [zhaochenyang@lmsys.org](mailto:zhaochenyang@lmsys.org). ## Citation If you use SGLang-Omni for your research, please cite our technical blogs on the [unified interactive runtime](https://www.sglang.io/blog/omni-interactive-runtime) and the [Stage--Process--GPU topology](https://www.sglang.io/blog/spg-topology): ```bibtex @misc{sglangomniinteractive2026, title={Unified Runtime for Full-Duplex Interactive Intelligence with {SGLang Omni}}, author={{SGLang-Omni Team}}, howpublished={\url{https://www.sglang.io/blog/omni-interactive-runtime}}, year={2026}, month={oct} } @misc{sglangomni2026, title={Fish Audio Drama 3 Meets {SGLang-Omni}: Day-0 Support and the Stage--Process--GPU Topology}, author={{SGLang-Omni Team}}, howpublished={\url{https://www.sglang.io/blog/spg-topology}}, year={2026}, month={oct} } ``` ## Acknowledgments SGLang-Omni builds on the SGLang ecosystem and on open model work from the TTS, speech, and omni-model communities. We thank the model teams, systems contributors, and partner organizations helping make open multimodal serving faster, more reliable, and easier to extend.
